R-BATTERY-FULL-WASTE.kidText: A full battery wastes extra power.

R-POWER-SHORT-OFFLINE.kidText: Not enough power; a module stayed off.
R-POWER-SHORT-OFFLINE.because: The power pool was too small.
R-POWER-SHORT-OFFLINE.try: Build power or switch modules off.

R-BLACKOUT-COLD.kidText: The habitat ran out of power.

R-AIR-BALANCE.kidText: Air changes when machines and crew work.
R-AIR-BALANCE.because: Machines make air while crew uses it.

R-AIR-THIN.kidText: Thin air makes the crew weak.

R-STORM-SHIELD.kidText: A storm hit the unshielded base.

R-SHELTER-TRADE.kidText: Shelter protects crew but costs power.
R-SHELTER-TRADE.try: Choose shelter when the storm is strong.

R-QUAKE-DUST.kidText: The quake covered panels with dust.
R-QUAKE-DUST.try: Save bricks for a quick repair.

R-LEAK-CHOICE.kidText: Your leak choice changed the next days.
R-LEAK-CHOICE.because: Earth help costs bricks or patching costs power.
R-LEAK-CHOICE.try: Pick the trade-off your base can afford.

R-HARVEST.kidText: The greenhouse helped the crew harvest.
